answer: In this PoA design, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocal honest service to retain influence; old endorsements cannot indefinitely bridge a sudden burst of activity. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust, while freshly spawned Sybil identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot meet consensus thresholds. A hollow cluster may wander among names, but without trusted interactions it gains no weight.
